items.label: D1
items.promptEn: Minji moved to Incheon two years ago. She still lives there. (live in)
accept: Minji has lived in Incheon for two years

items.label: D2
items.promptEn: My mom started to run a fashion company in 2007. She still runs it. (run)
accept: My mom has run a fashion company since 2007
